title: Portable project handoff and recovery on isolated copies

required_steps.description: Save As a paired project through GUI; preserve original input
Cold reopen in a new process; inspect Project Browser after whole-folder relocation
On copies only remove derived caches; rebuild with processor and source unavailable
Exercise relink failure and recovery, cancel, stale revision and damaged-copy rejection
Explicitly migrate a legacy copy; preserve original legacy bytes

comparison_rules.science: Exact UUID/revision and authoritative array hashes; same frame properties where applicable
comparison_rules.render: Inspect view restoration separately; blend binary equality is not required
comparison_rules.deletion: Only explicitly identified derived caches in isolated test copies
comparison_rules.availability: Demonstrate processor and source unavailability during rebuild, not merely absence of calls in a log
